nodes.label: arith.py — the arithmetic audit as a program
nodes.rationale: DOCKET.md section 2's per-section check run as a class over whole members: extract the arithmetic the volumes state about themselves, recompute in Decimal, report a verdict per claim.

nodes.label: Six verdicts, two of them findings
nodes.rationale: Only DISAGREE and ROUNDING-SENSITIVE are findings; AGREE, WITHIN-INPUT-PRECISION, NOT-BOUND and UNCHECKABLE are not.

nodes.label: Never round with round()
nodes.rationale: Every comparison is Decimal.quantize at the precision the text itself states, under a named convention printed above every report.

nodes.label: NOT-BOUND — a co-located pair is not a claim
nodes.rationale: A fraction and a percentage on one line are not a claim unless the text binds them; binders are ranked, and 223 of 296 reader-facing claims are NOT-BOUND. The 311/311 against 57% site is the shape of the trap.

nodes.label: ROUNDING-SENSITIVE — it never picks the convention for you
nodes.rationale: 1 of 8 = 13% is 13 under HALF_UP and 12 under HALF_EVEN; which the text meant is not the tool's to decide.

nodes.label: An equation chain asserts all members equal
nodes.rationale: Pairing only the first = with what follows reads the second expression as a scalar and manufactures defects; MC section 10.3's three-member chain to 976 is one AGREE, not two defects.

nodes.label: Only a dangling operator licenses a join
nodes.rationale: The corpus's own convention reads a wrapped roster on the whitespace-normalised join; joining two adjacent table rows would fabricate arithmetic the text never states.

nodes.label: WITHIN-INPUT-PRECISION — a count is exact, a decimal is not
nodes.rationale: Intervals of half an ulp propagate through products and sums, so a six-factor product to four decimals is not faulted; integer operands carry no interval and are not softened.

nodes.label: mc:2930 — 146 of 163 = 92%, and it is 89.57%
nodes.rationale: Bound by the text's own =, occurring exactly once in the store with no nearby entry stating 89.6%: the first landing of the ARITHMETIC defect class that L1407 says has caught nothing. Recorded, not repaired.

nodes.label: main:1413 — 33 x 5 = 166, quoted deliberately wrong
nodes.rationale: The ARITHMETIC class's own illustration; the verdict is correct and the site is not a defect. The tool cannot tell a defect asserted from a defect quoted.
